Name: Bomberman Buddies
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
Here's some more cute animals for your farm. Thi[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/itsallup][/url]s time they are modified from a few Bomberman games. Mostly Saturn Bomberman and Bomberman 94/ Mega Bomberman/ Bomberman 08 (those three are all versions of the same game)

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Big Snails![/size][/color][/b]
They come in 7 styles, referencing different video game snails. They can drop an ice cream and a cookie, and eventually snails as well. Snails can also be used in an Ostrich Incubator to make new baby Big Snails. The style with the spikes and sunglasses is made to reference [color=#6aa84f][b]Snailser [/b][/color]from [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/itsallup]Smight's show Arcade Pit[/url] which is quite entertaining and I highly suggest checking it out.

[b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Louies![/size][/color][/b]
Bomberman's ridable kangroo buddies. Comes in 6 colors. They have an ice cream, a cookie, and kangaroo leather for drops. 

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Tyras![/b][/size][/color]
Bomberman's also ridable pals who are like, dinosaurs, or rhinos, or something like those. They're cool, also with six colors.. They will also provide you with an ice cream, a cookie, and sometimes their horns.

Each ice cream will give you a different temporary buff. The cookies will give the same buff, but last all day long. An attempt was made to make them make sense to the powerup they are designed after. Skate gives speed, Fire gives attack and crit, Bomb gives attack speed to simulate "more bombs" as "more hits". Hopefully.

There is a config option to choose which name you prefer for the animals, since they have different spellings and such. Also includes a more generic name for each. You can change these at any time but it seems like animals stay with whatever you had set when you buy them so perhaps make your choices and then buy. Not sure if this can cause issues, let me know if it does.

There is an AHM addon mod which will allow you to get meat from all three animals and also give them treats. Snails and Louies are herbivores, Tyras like meat, eggs, and fruit. My other mods Jerky Time and Carnivore Trees will also support these new meats.

If you have a mod that also has dinosaurs that are similar to rhinos or vice versa (ie mario Dino-Rhinos, pokemon's Rhyhorn and Rhydon etc) you may feel free to use the meat and horn items from this mod. They have the generic name Rhinosaur Horn and Rhinosaur Meat for this purpose. Not impossible that Livestock Dinos might add Dino-Rhinos someday but ehh not super likely.  The Louies animal items are also generically Kangaroo Leather and Kangaroo Meat for this same usage. If you make something neat, lemme know.
